info.description: Billing's HTTP API (LLD §5). Identity comes only from gateway- or mesh-injected x-user-id, x-tenant-id and x-tenant-roles (§5.1); errors are RFC 9457 problems (application/problem+json) with the §17 errorCode. B-W1 (provider webhooks) is documented in §5.4.3.
